result.topic_en: Draft from Riemann's dissertation: the boundary integral of $u\,\partial u'/\partial p - u'\,\partial u/\partial p$ stays zero even when the surface T has isolated points or lines of discontinuity, provided these are cut out by small surface pieces taken as boundary.
